name: zeekr-shortcut-sentrymode-on
description: Turns on Zeekr sentry mode when the car is parked outside your geofences (Cloudflare Workers)
author: dts88

ZEEKR_EMAIL.description: Email of a second Zeekr account that your car is shared with. Not the account in your phone's Zeekr app, or the app gets signed out.

GEOFENCES.description: Places where sentry mode is never turned on, up to 10, separated by semicolons. Each: name, latitude, longitude, radius in metres (default 600). Example: Home, 1.3521, 103.8198, 600

STATE.description: Storage for the sign-in session and the current parking. Keep new.
